title: Herbal Crumbly Algerian Potatoes Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic solo-dinner dish featuring small potatoes and a tangy kimchi sauce, inspired by traditional Algerian cuisine.

ingredients.name: kimchi (fermented Korean chili flakes and cabbage)

instructions: Peel and halve the potatoes, and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
In a separate bowl, mix together the kimchi, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and allspice.
Pour the kimchi mixture over the potatoes and toss to coat.
Transfer the potatoes to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and golden brown.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley and cilantro.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
